name: Overloaded Brain Grenade
text:
Activate 2 Interact

---

It's possible for a desperate alchemist to rig the brain container of a defeated alchemical golem to create a volatile (if unusual) explosive. You throw the grenade up to 60 feet, and it explodes, dealing 3d6 fire damage and 3d6 mental damage in a 10-foot burst (DC 27 basic Reflex save save).

On a critical failure, a creature takes 2d6 persistent,fire damage.

Craft Requirements Supply a brain case harvested from alchemical golem
